title: Steps to jump-start a car with cables
summary: Check both vehicle manuals, the battery condition and designated jump points before connecting cables.

blocks.title: Jump-start in the right order
blocks.body: First read the jump-start instructions for both vehicles. Confirm a compatible 12 V negative-ground setup and that the donor may be used. Hybrids, EVs and some conventional vehicles have special restrictions and remote jump points. If either manual prohibits the procedure, use roadside assistance.

blocks.heading: Connect the cables in this order
items: Stop if the battery is frozen, cracked, leaking or visibly damaged. Work away from flames; wear eye protection and keep cables clear of fans and belts.
For vehicles whose manuals specify this common order: with vehicles secured, not touching, and power states as instructed, connect red to the disabled vehicle’s designated positive point.
Connect the other red to donor positive, then black to donor negative.
Connect the last black to the disabled vehicle’s designated ground point, away from the battery. Do not guess a ground location.
Follow the manuals for donor operation, wait time and cranking limits. Stop if cables heat, abnormal sparking occurs or the vehicle fails to start within the permitted attempts.

blocks.title: Why the last clamp goes to metal
blocks.body: The designated final ground connection keeps a possible connection spark away from battery gases. Keep clamps from touching each other or unintended metal. The vehicle manual’s specified points and sequence govern.

blocks.heading: Once it starts
items: Disconnect in the prescribed reverse order while keeping clamps apart and clear of moving parts.
Arrange battery/charging-system evaluation and proper charging. A short drive is not proof of a fully recharged or healthy battery.

blocks.heading: If it will not crank at all
blocks.body: Repeated cranking is not a diagnosis. Stop at the manufacturer’s attempt limit and call assistance if the setup or failure is unclear. Do not improvise terminal repairs while connected to a donor.
